description: This file implements a gRPC service handler for control environment operations, including listing services and methods, retrieving full service/method names, and making gRPC calls via command-line interface. It interacts with gRPC servers, processes command arguments, and outputs JSON-formatted results.

classes.name: InsecureCliCredentials
classes.description: A class providing insecure gRPC channel credentials for testing purposes.

methods.name: PrintStream
methods.description: Outputs a string to a stringstream.

methods.name: CombineArgumentsAndOptions
methods.description: Combines command-line arguments and options into a vector of C-style strings for gRPC CLI invocation.

methods.name: RunGrpcCommand
methods.description: Executes a gRPC command with given arguments and options, capturing output.

methods.name: GetServiceList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available gRPC services from a server.

methods.name: GetServerAddress
methods.description: Finds the server address corresponding to a specific service name.

methods.name: GetFullServiceName
methods.description: Gets the full qualified name of a service from a server.

methods.name: GetFullMethodName
methods.description: Constructs the full method name for a gRPC call.

methods.name: HandleLsCmd
methods.description: Handles the 'ls' command to list services or methods, outputting JSON.

methods.name: HandleTypeCmd
methods.description: Handles the 'type' command to get the type of a service.

methods.name: HandleCallCmd
methods.description: Handles the 'call' command to invoke a gRPC method with JSON input.

methods.name: HandleCmds
methods.description: Main entry point to handle various gRPC control commands based on arguments.
